Good afternoon everyone and welcome to the special council meeting on Monday May 5,
2025. Individuals interested in participating in this meeting were eligible to register
online using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca slash delegation or via
email at delegation at kitchener.ca. Any written comments received prior to the commencement
of the meeting have been circulated to members of Council and will form part of the public
record.
The meeting live stream and archived videos are available at www.kitchener.ca.
Before we begin the meeting, I'd like to acknowledge that we're gathering on the traditional territory
of the neutral Anishinaabeg and Haudenosaunee peoples.
We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards for the land and honour the original
caretakers who came before us.
Are communities enriched by the enduring knowledge and deep-rooted traditions of the diverse
First Nations, Métis and Inuit in Kitchener today?
Are there any disclosures of pecuniary interest?
There being none and no delegations and no mayoral business, motion to go in camera for
three items as listed on the agenda.
Moved by Councillor Michaud, seconded by Councillor Stretch.
All those in favour?
Opposed?
